messages:
ana_docs: @legal_june quick ping — legal flagged our APAC endpoint doc. The SDK snippet still says 'data stored in EU' which is wrong for APAC customers. Can someone help propose wording and a tiny code sample? :wave:

mike_h: I can take a pass. Where's the snippet?

ana_docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/regions#data-residency — snippet under 'SDK examples'. Current text: "Data is stored in EU (for protection)". Legal wants something clearer for APAC availability.

sasha: small nit — we should avoid a hard promise for hosted tier. Suggest: "Requests for customers who select APAC endpoints are processed in APAC regions; hosted accounts may have cross-region fallback for redundancy. Contact sales for dedicated residency." :thinking_face:

legal_june: +1 to the conservative approach. Proposed concise copy: "Requests routed to APAC endpoints are processed in APAC regions. For hosted customers, cross-region processing may occur for redundancy or failover; customers requiring strict residency should consider Dedicated or Private deployments and contact sales."

mike_h: I'll update the SDK snippet and add a footnote link to the residency policy. Draft snippet update below:

```js
// SDK example: APAC base URL
const client = new Redwood({ baseURL: 'https://apac.api.redwood.com' });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hello' });
// Note: requests to APAC endpoints are processed in APAC regions; see docs for residency details: https://redwood.dev/legal/data-residency
```

ana_docs: can you also add a one-line footnote under the example pointing to /legal/data-residency and mention Dedicated/Private for strict needs?

mike_h: yep, done in PR #4821 — added footnote and tweaked wording for hosted vs dedicated. cc @sasha @legal_june

deploy-bot: PR 4821 merged to staging by mike_h :arrow_up_small: 

sasha: lgtm, i added one sentence about disaster-recovery exceptions and a link to the infra runbook.

ana_docs: thanks all — scheduling a 10-min check with infra to confirm cache/kv cross-region TTLs before prod push.

legal_june: Approved from legal side. :white_check_mark:

ana_docs: Closing this thread. Updated prod copy and SDK snippet will go live after infra confirmation. :tada:
